_doc: The global npm and pip packages forge toolchain checks under the current node and python, and forge toolchain --fix installs at the pinned version when they are missing (a package that is present at another version is only reported). forge init no longer writes this file: a stranger's GSD is unpatched and comes from pnpm dlx (gsd_patches false), so nothing is pinned; copy it to config/toolchain.json to pin a package by hand. Add an entry per package: {"name": ..., "version": ..., "why": ...}.

npm.name: get-shit-done-cc
npm.why: GSD's runtime: scripts/sync/sync_gsd_runtime.py stages the package's own installer to regenerate the gsd agents, engine and skills
